BluSky Rithmic NinjaTrader Connection Guide

BluSky Connection Guide

Updated this week
Steps to Set Up a Rithmic-Based BluSky Connection:
1. Complete Account Activation

Ensure that you've completed the necessary steps to activate your BluSky account on our website.

2. Download & Sign Into R|Trader Pro to accept the Market Data Agreements:

Sign Data Agreements: (Web) https://downloads.rithmic.com/BluSkyAgreement/apps.html#login

Click Here to Download R|Trader Pro

Open R|Trader Pro and log in using your BluSky credentials.

Ensure Market Data is OFF and selective mode is OFF.

Log in with:

System: BluSky

Gateway: Chicago Area

Sign the mandatory Market Data Agreements as a Non-Professional.

Now, just minimize the R|Trader Pro window. You are done with it for now.

3. Create a NinjaTrader Username (if you don't have one):

Go to NinjaTrader.com and sign up to create a username.

After creating your username, activate it through the confirmation email.

4. Configure NinjaTrader Connection:

Download and make sure the Version number is 8.1.9.0 and greater.

Open NinjaTrader and sign in with your NinjaTrader username.

If you don't see the configure button, enable "Multi-provider Mode" in Tools > Options > General > Multi-provider mode > Then restart NinjaTrader and sign back in.

Go to Control Center > Connections > configure.

Double-click "Rithmic for NinjaTrader Brokerage" from the 'Available' list.

Enter your BluSky credentials, set the System to, "BluSky (Chicago)" and click OK.

Connect by selecting "My Rithmic for NinjaTrader Brokerage" from the Connections menu.

Troubleshooting: If you can connect, but don't see the account:

If you are able to connect to your BluSky Credentials within NinjaTrader, but the evaluation account isn't showing, please write in to

ClientServices@NinjaTrader.com with:

Your Email Address

NinjaTrader Username

Indicate BluSky as the Evaluation Service

 

Note: If the Evaluation (Rithmic) Entitlement is missing, it doesn't prevent the connection from turning green and connecting. However, the Evaluation account won't be visible within the NinjaTrader platform until this has been enabled.
​
For any further inquiries, feel free to reach out to the BluSky Support Desk:
